blocking_issue.impact_chain: The registry can only record a frozen parent in a later commit while the scope guard and CORE Gate currently require that earlier parent to also be HEAD and the canonical remote, so no exact candidate can satisfy both checks.
blocking_issue.minimum_fix: Rename the marker to freeze_parent_commit, make the marker commit the sole formal candidate, and verify that its direct-parent diff changes only the active-slice freeze fields.
blocking_issue.reproduction: Create code candidate C, commit the registry freeze marker as F with frozen_candidate_commit=C, then run scope validation and CoreCandidateContext against the same clean checkout and canonical remote.
blocking_issue.stop_condition: Stop when one combined test proves scope frozen validation and CORE candidate context both bind F, while C, non-marker diffs and post-F tracked changes are rejected.

active_slice.minimum_change: Repair only the freeze-parent versus formal-candidate contradiction in the existing scope contract; do not change CORE candidate equality or add durable state, cryptography, authority, custody or services.
active_slice.stop_condition: Stop if the fix needs CORE Gate relaxation, database state, a migration, HMAC, an authority protocol, custody, a new service, more than the declared paths or a higher budget.
active_slice.user_outcome: G01 can freeze one exact commit and run its final CORE Gate without an impossible candidate self-reference.
